verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a SaaS sales-tax platform, but the evidence never documents a bulk export of account data in open formats. The API evidence covers reading tax rates and categories and pushing transactions in, not exporting everything out. The 'Archive of historical sales tax data' pricing line is about data retention, not portability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
